At WWP™, we recognize our mission cannot be accomplished without our talented teammates, which is why we’re proud to offer benefits such as:

A flexible hybrid work schedule (three days in the office, two days’ work from home)
Full medical, dental, and vision coverage for both teammates AND family members

Perform print and data proofing and provide feedback to internal stakeholders.
Support brand compliance and consistency across WWP marketing initiatives and partner campaign materials (e.g., messaging framework, visual assets, and key terminology).
Assist with maintaining Corporate Giving web page updates and Corporate Partner branding exposure.
Assist with research on corporate giving trends and creative best practices across marketing platforms.
Support, attend, or participate in WWP events, campaigns, and other initiatives as required.
Provide general project support for the Marketing – Business Development team.
Support overall Donor Engagement Marketing team initiatives.

The Wounded Warrior Project (WWP) Vice President of Marketing Strategy & Audience Growth leads the development of audience-centered marketing strategies that increase awareness, acquisition, engagement, advocacy, and brand affinity across warriors, donors, supporters, and other key stakeholder groups. This role oversees audience insights, market intelligence, and integrated planning, translating research and data into strategies that advance organizational priorities and long-term growth. As a member of the Marketing & Communications leadership team, the Vice President sets the strategic direction for brand positioning, audience planning, campaign development, fundraising marketing, and program marketing. Working closely with senior leaders across the organization, this role ensures marketing efforts are aligned, audience focused, and positioned to achieve WWP goals.

DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES

Lead enterprise-wide audience growth strategies that increase awareness, acquisition, engagement, retention, and advocacy in support of WWP's mission, strategic priorities, recruitment objectives, fundraising goals, and brand growth.
Serve as the organization's subject matter expert on audience behavior, motivations, and emerging market trends, identifying opportunities and risks that may impact growth and relevance.
Lead the development and application of audience research, market intelligence, brand studies, and performance analytics, translating insights into strategic recommendations that improve audience growth, campaign effectiveness, and brand performance.
Establish audience segmentation frameworks, personas, and audience journey maps that inform marketing strategy, planning, and execution.
Lead integrated marketing strategy and annual planning processes, aligning audience needs, organizational priorities, and business objectives.
Provide strategic direction for major campaigns, fundraising initiatives, program marketing efforts, and enterprise-wide marketing priorities.
Partner with organizational leaders to identify opportunities and coordinate marketing strategies across audiences, channels, and stakeholder groups to maximize impact.
Guide long-term brand positioning strategies that strengthen awareness, trust, and relevance among key audiences.
Partner with the Communications leadership team to ensure audience insights inform messaging, storytelling, and stakeholder engagement efforts.
Lead and develop a high-performing team responsible for audience strategy, research, planning, and growth initiatives.
Present strategic recommendations, performance results, and market insights to executive leadership and key stakeholders.
Foster a culture of innovation, accountability, continuous learning, and data-informed decision-making.
Attend and actively participate in required training and/or meetings, including but not limited to New Teammate Orientation, WWP Cares, ASIST Suicide Prevention training, Leadership training, culture/team based training, or departmental huddles.
Other related duties as assigned.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, & ABILITIES

Deep expertise in audience strategy, growth marketing, brand strategy, and integrated campaign planning, with demonstrated success developing enterprise strategies that drive measurable audience growth and organizational outcomes.
Advanced understanding of audience segmentation, persona development, customer journeys, market research, and analytics, with the ability to translate data and insights into actionable recommendations.
Ability to develop cohesive enterprise strategies across marketing, communications, digital, content, and external engagement.
Strong executive presence with demonstrated success influencing senior leaders, Board members, and external partners and building consensus across complex stakeholder groups.
Exceptional critical thinking, strategic judgment, and problem-solving abilities, with the ability to balance long-term vision and practical execution.
Excellent written and verbal communication, facilitation, and presentation skills, with the ability to convey complex strategies and insights clearly to executive, Board, and stakeholder audiences.
Proven ability to lead through change, navigate ambiguity, prioritize competing opportunities, and allocate resources toward the highest-value initiatives.
Strong leadership, coaching, talent development, and team-building skills.
High emotional intelligence and cultural competency, with demonstrated sensitivity to military and veteran experiences.
Demonstrated commitment to ethical leadership, accountability, collaboration, and organizational stewardship.
Passion for mission-driven work and the ability to translate audience insights and marketing strategy into meaningful impact for warriors and their families.
Unequivocal commitment to the highest standards of personal and business ethics and conduct.
Mission-driven, guided by core values, and a pleasure to work with.

EXPERIENCE

Requirements

Ten years of progressively responsible experience in marketing strategy, audience growth, brand strategy, integrated marketing, communications, or related functions.
Eight years of senior leadership experience building, leading, and developing high-performing teams in complex organizations.

Preferences

Twelve years of experience in marketing strategy, audience growth, brand strategy, integrated marketing, communications, or related functions, including leadership at the executive level.
Experience in a nonprofit, membership, advocacy, healthcare, veteran services, or other mission-driven organization.
Experience managing brand positioning, brand evolution, or enterprise-wide reputation initiatives.

EDUCATION

Bachelor’s degree in marketing, communications, business administration, or related field.

Preferences

Master’s degree in marketing, communications, business administration, or related field.

Valid state-issued driver’s license.

Preferences

None.

General office environment; temperature controlled.
Sitting for extended periods.
Up to 25% travel.

added.description:
Oak View Group

Oak View Group (OVG) is the global leader in premium live entertainment infrastructure and services, with a platform spanning venue development and end-to-end capabilities across venue management, hospitality, and sponsorship sales. Founded in 2015, the company serves a collection of seven world-class owned venues and a client roster of the most iconic arenas, stadiums, convention centers, music festivals, performing arts centers, and cultural institutions, spanning four continents.

Position Summary

Oak View Group is seeking a dynamic Marketing Manager
to lead promotional campaigns across Lexington's premier entertainment portfolio: Rupp Arena, Central Bank Center, the Lexington Opera House, and the OVG Concert Series at Gatton Park. This Marketing Manager position will develop, manage, and execute strategic marketing plans to ensure the success of events. The position will serve as a venue marketer, responsible for overseeing event advertising budgets, the media buying process, public relations, and grassroots promotions for concerts, family shows, and conventions.

This role pays an annual salary of $50,000 - $55,000.

Benefits for Full-Time Roles: Health, Dental, and Vision Insurance, 401(k) Savings Plan, 401(k) matching, and Paid Time Off (vacation days, sick days, and 11 holidays)

This position will remain open until December 31, 2026.

About The Venue

Lexington is an active and thriving market, craving an active and welcoming venue for events. The heart of any thriving community is its downtown—and Lexington Center and the historic Rupp Arena
are truly the heart of downtown Lexington and one of the most widely recognized entertainment venues in North America. Rupp Arena in Lexington, Kentucky, is fast becoming THE must-play venue. The 20,000-seat arena, affectionately referred to by some as “the Cathedral of College Basketball," is home to the National Champion University of Kentucky men’s basketball program and has played host to some of the most talented and award-winning musicians/artists in the world, including U2, Paul McCartney, Elton John, Justin Timberlake, Kenny Chesney, Taylor Swift, and many others.

Central Bank Center is our convention side, with over 99k sf of exhibition space, 24k sf each of meeting and ballroom space, 50k of hospitality space, 10k sf of flexible space, and over 2500 covered and uncovered parking spaces. Both venues are additionally joined in entertaining this area by the Lexington Opera House, showcasing Broadway talent through collaborative bookings of Broadway shows, small venue concerts, and local arts.

CommonSpirit Health Stage at Gatton Park is a 5,000-capacity outdoor venue located in the center of Lexington. From live music and stand-up comedy to unforgettable experiences set against a stunning park backdrop in the center of the city.

Founded in 2021, Lexington Sporting Club is an American professional soccer team based in Lexington, KY. The soccer complex off Athens-Boonesboro Road near I-75 opened in August 2024 in time for the organization’s first USL Super League season.

Responsibilities

Conceptualize, develop, and execute comprehensive marketing campaigns to promote concerts, comedy shows, theater productions, and live events at Rupp Arena, the Lexington Opera House, Central Bank Center, and the OVG Concert Series at Gatton Park
Develop and implement creative cash/trade proposals with media partners, including digital, radio, print, TV, and outdoor
Create and maintain collaborative relationships with local media partners, promoters, tour marketers, and community partners to ensure fully aligned event campaigns
Explore and execute cross-marketing opportunities throughout the community and execute grassroots marketing, including but not limited to ticket giveaways, on-site activations, and third-party partnerships
Manage internal marketing assets, oversee digital displays and marquee messaging, and maintain the venue website
Manage event advertising budgets, oversee the media buying and billing process, and implement multi-channel advertising strategies
Draft, distribute, and follow up on press releases, pitching feature stories to local and regional media for upcoming events and venue initiatives
Conceptualize and collaborate on social media campaigns, email and SMS marketing, and promotions to drive ticket sales and fan engagement
Track, analyze, and compare event ticket sales information, adjusting digital targeting parameters and overall efforts based on gathered analytics from previous events
Prepare post-show recaps and manage post-event survey evaluations to measure attendee feedback and analyze venue operations
Research and follow current venue and event marketing trends, implementing best practices in day-to-day activations
Recruit and manage marketing interns and part-time employees
Perform other duties as assigned

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree from an accredited college or university or equivalent work experiences
3-5 years of previous event or entertainment marketing experience preferred
Intermediate to strong knowledge of Adobe Creative Suite
Strong knowledge of social media platforms (Facebook, Instagram, X, TikTok, etc.)
Demonstrated proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite
Basic photography and videography skills with proficiency in editing images/videos using the following software: Adobe, Canva, and CapCut
Independent decision-making skills; ability and knowledge to apply judgment in resolving problems of moderate scope and complexity
Highly organized, resourceful, quick learner, and able to handle multiple projects simultaneously
Ability to prioritize and meet deadlines
Must be adaptable with the ability to work under pressure to meet deadlines
Must be able to work a flexible schedule inclusive of weekends, nights, and holidays required
Frequent bending, lifting objects, sitting, exposure to multiple external elements, extensive walking through the building

Strengthened by our Differences. United to Make a Difference

At OVG, we understand that to continue positively disrupting the sports and live entertainment industry, we need a diverse team to help us do it. We also believe that inclusivity drives innovation, strengthens our people
, improves our service
, and raises our excellence
. Our success is rooted in creating environments that reflect and celebrate the diverse communities in which we operate and serve, and this is the reason we are committed to amplifying voices from all different backgrounds.

Marketing Manager - Las Vegas Resident Shows

Sales, Marketing & Communications

Full-Time Position

Cirque du Soleil Entertainment Group (“CDSEG”) is seeking a dynamic and results-driven Marketing Manager to lead promotional and strategic marketing efforts for our Las Vegas resident shows.

Reporting to the Director of Marketing, this role is responsible for developing, executing, and optimizing integrated marketing strategies that drive awareness, engagement, and ticket sales. The ideal candidate is a creative thinker with strong analytical skills, thrives in a fast-paced entertainment environment, and is passionate about storytelling and audience growth.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Planning & Execution

In collaboration with the Director of Marketing, and Senior Director of Marketing & Brand, define and implement the annual marketing strategies for Cirque du Soleil Las Vegas resident shows
Develop and oversee comprehensive marketing plans to reach both visitor and local audiences, maximizing visibility across traditional, digital, and experiential channels
Monitor performance against KPIs, proactively adjusting strategies to meet revenue and attendance goals within approved budget parameters
Identify new opportunities and innovative marketing tactics to test and refine throughout the year

Market & Media Oversight

Serve as the in-market marketing lead, providing ongoing assessments of visibility, competitive positioning, and new opportunities across Las Vegas
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to optimize media and advertising for maximum ROI and implement initiatives to support short-term and long-term growth opportunities
Manage agency relationships and oversee campaign execution, including creative production, trafficking, and performance analysis

Creative & Brand Management

Partner with the creative teams to maintain the integrity of each show’s brand identity while innovating on-market creative approaches
Lead the development of new advertising materials, print, digital, video, out-of-home, and experiential, to ensure consistent storytelling across all platforms
Collaborate on photo/video shoots, in-market activations, and content initiatives supporting seasonal campaigns and special events

Partnerships & Collaboration

Ensure compliance with all partnership agreements and coordinate approvals as needed

Budget & Administration

Manage annual marketing and media budgets for assigned shows, including forecasting, accruals, and invoice processing
Track and evaluate campaign results, compiling post-campaign recaps and actionable insights for leadership
Oversee vendors and production schedules to ensure timely and cost-effective delivery of assets

Additional Duties

Support cross-show portfolio marketing initiatives when applicable
Complete all other job-related duties as assigned

Qualifications & Skills

Bachelor’s Degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or related field
At least 3 years of marketing experience, preferably in entertainment, hospitality, or live events
Proven track record managing integrated marketing campaigns from strategy to execution
Strong analytical, project management, and presentation skills
Excellent communication and relationship-building abilities across all organizational levels
Experience managing external agencies and cross-functional teams
Proficient in Microsoft Office and comfortable analyzing data to inform strategy
Knowledge of Las Vegas market and visitor trends is highly preferred
Ability to work flexible hours and occasionally attend events or activations on evenings and weekends
Fluent in English, both written and spoken
Verification of the right to work in the United States for Cirque du Soleil Entertainment Group, as demonstrated by completion of the Form I-9 upon hire and the submission of acceptable documentation (as noted on the Form I-9) verifying one’s identity and work authorization

As you can imagine, working with a circus can be quite different from other organizations, and at Cirque du Soleil Entertainment Group, we embrace these differences loudly with enthusiasm. We realize that one size fits none and invite you to come create your own specialized experience with us to see exactly what we’re talking about, firsthand.

Our emotion-provoking shows are just the tip of the iceberg: laced throughout our organization, you will find creative minds who are empowered to use their voices and be themselves, their truest selves. Diversity to us means various perspectives, fresh ideas and continuous improvement of the way we do things. We won’t pretend like we have every answer, that’s why we need you! The employees here are the center of what we do, the voices behind the final product and amazing performances on stage.

Teamwork - we thrive with collaborative teams, regardless of titles or departments;
Respect - when we ask someone to join our team, it’s because we trust and respect you;
Integrity - whether you work behind-the-scenes or in the office, you’re being counted on. We are a team and integrity goes a long way here, and like we mentioned previously, trust is important;
Authenticity - we want you to bring your full self to work, this is a place where you don’t need to fit into a box to belong; diverse perspectives foster even more creativity in the workplace. We embrace the human behind the employee number;
Being heard - you have access to everyone in the organization, use your voice on development questions or suggestions on how to improve the experience. We value open and transparent communication, and we want you to be heard!

The role owns the regional execution layer of the marketing operating model, connecting UCANZ Marketing with Crunchyroll’s global capabilities across Integrated Planning, Campaign Operations, Marketing Production, Global Localization and Marketing Delivery. The role reports to UCANZ Regional Marketing leadership or the designated Regional Operations leader and works closely with Campaign Operations, Marketing Production, Marketing Delivery, Regional Marketing, Title Marketing, Brand Management, Creative Services, Partnerships, Social, CRM, Paid Media, Content, Curation & Programming and global centers of excellence. At Anchorage Digital, we are building the world’s most advanced digital asset platform for institutions to participate in crypto.

Anchorage Digital is a crypto platform that enables institutions to participate in digital assets through custody, staking, trading, governance, settlement, and the industry's leading security infrastructure. Home to Anchorage Digital Bank N.A., the first federally chartered crypto bank in the U.S., Anchorage Digital also serves institutions through Anchorage Digital Singapore, Porto by Anchorage Digital , and other offerings.

The company is funded by leading institutions including Andreessen Horowitz, GIC, Goldman Sachs, KKR, and Visa, with its Series D valuation over $3 billion. Founded in 2017 in San Francisco, California, Anchorage Digital has offices in New York, New York; Porto, Portugal; Singapore; and Sioux Falls, South Dakota. Learn more at anchorage.com, on X @Anchorage, and on LinkedIn.

With the evolving landscape of digital threats and an increasing volume of sophisticated attacks by malicious actors, we have a security policy mandating all new hires complete an in-person onboarding process - no exceptions
. Security is our foundation and we prioritize physical identity verification and secure IT setup. While our security and IT logistics require physical presence to protect our infrastructure from sophisticated global threats, this move is equally about our Village culture. We believe that a laptop can be shipped, but our culture cannot.

We are looking to add a Senior Product Marketing Manager, Stablecoins - Infrastructure to our team.

You will own how Anchorage Digital positions and takes to market its stablecoin infrastructure: the platform institutions use to mint, redeem, bridge, custody, settle, and manage USD stablecoins through a federally chartered bank, plus the API and developer surface behind it and the payments service that lets banks move dollars onchain without a correspondent bank.

Your buyers are the people who run money movement and treasury: payments and treasury leads at banks and fintechs, trading desks and exchanges that settle in stablecoins, and the engineers and product managers who integrate against our API. They care about speed, cost, counterparty risk, and regulatory standing, and they are comparing us to crypto-native infrastructure providers, bank consortia, and doing nothing.

This is a generalist product marketing role on a small team. Product marketing is the core of the job, and you will also carry brand, events, and communications work for your product lines: the launch announcement, the developer content, the conference presence, the client reference program. You should be as comfortable writing a technical one-pager as briefing a designer or prepping an executive for a panel.

We have created the Factors of Growth & Impact to help Villagers better measure impact and articulate coaching, feedback, and the rich and rewarding learning that happens while exploring, developing, and mastering the capabilities and contributions within and outside of the Senior Product Marketing Manager, Stablecoins - Infrastructure role:

Technical Skills:

Write the positioning, messaging, and ICP definition for stablecoin infrastructure, covering minting and redemption, settlement, treasury, bank payments, and the API, and keep them current as the products and the market move.
Build and maintain the sales toolkit: pitch decks, one-pagers, solution pages, competitive battlecards, FAQs, integration overviews, and client case studies, and train Sales on how to use them.
Run product launches end to end: new chains and stablecoins supported, new API capabilities, pricing changes, and new bank services, with the announcement, developer content, website and in-app updates, and enablement ready on day one.
Produce content for an institutional and technical audience, from web copy and blog posts to developer guides, white papers, webinars, and conference talks, in the Anchorage Digital voice.

Complexity & Impact of Work:

Turn infrastructure concepts (settlement finality, reserve handling, bridging, treasury operations) into a clear business case for a treasurer, a payments lead, and an engineer, and decide which proof points each one needs.
Build competitive positioning against crypto-native infrastructure providers and bank consortia, and make the case for running money movement through a federally chartered bank in plain terms a buyer can repeat internally.
Own the brand, events, and communications calendar for your product lines, including developer and payments conference presence, speaking submissions, and executive prep.

Organizational Knowledge:

Develop fluency in how our platform and API work, which stablecoins and chains we support, and the regulatory standing that shapes what we can say.
Partner with Product and Engineering on roadmap priorities using client interviews, integration feedback, win and loss analysis, and market research.
Work with Legal and Compliance so every external claim survives review the first time.

Communication & Influence:

Gather client, prospect, developer, and competitor insight and share it across Marketing, Product, Sales, and the Stablecoin Solutions team.
Act as the marketing point of contact for the stablecoin infrastructure business, and bring the broader Marketing team (design, demand generation, social, communications) into your launches.

You may be a fit for this role if you have:

Have 5 or more years in B2B product marketing, with at least part of that marketing an API, platform, or infrastructure product in fintech, payments, financial services, or digital assets.
Have owned positioning and go-to-market for a technical product end to end, from ICP and messaging through launch and sales enablement, and can show the results.
Write clearly for both a treasurer and an engineer, in short form and long form, and can explain settlement, minting and redemption, or a bridge between chains without a glossary.
Have worked on brand, events, or communications programs, not only product marketing, and are happy to carry those for your product lines on a small team.
Have sold alongside a sales team: built the deck, trained the reps, sat in on the calls, and changed the pitch based on what you heard.
Are comfortable with regulatory and compliance review, and treat it as part of getting the story right rather than an obstacle.
Search constantly for client, prospect, developer, and competitor insight and use it to change what we build and say.

Although not a requirement, bonus points if:

Have marketed payments infrastructure, a developer platform, or a settlement or treasury product.
Have worked with developer relations or produced developer-facing content such as integration guides and API overviews.
Have marketed to banks, and understand how a bank evaluates a new vendor for money movement.
Follow stablecoin settlement, bank adoption of onchain payments, and the GENIUS Act closely and have opinions about where the market goes next.
Were emotionally moved by the soundtrack to Hamilton, which chronicles the founding of a new financial system.

The Anchorage Village, what we call our team, brings together the brightest minds from platform security, financial services, and distributed ledger technology to provide the building blocks that empower institutions to safely participate in the evolving digital asset ecosystem. As a diverse team of more than 600 members, we are united in one common goal: building the future of finance by providing the foundation upon which value moves safely in the new global economy.
